10:  - Conditional: it guesses concretely when `evaluate::reduce` picks a branch (resolver/collected.rs:116-120; evaluate.rs:1-5, 39). It also reduces at prop-set level (alias.rs:360-362). Otherwise it is opaque `conditionalType` (collected.rs:121-122).
11:  - Mapped: a bare mapped type is opaque `mappedType` (collected.rs:124-127). A standalone `keyof` is too (85-95), except `keyof typeof const`, which is evaluated (88-91). `Partial`/`Required`/`Omit`/`Pick`/`Record` are evaluated concretely (substitute.rs:439-477, alias.rs:40, 69, 885-893). So are `Exclude`/`Extract` (alias.rs:995-999, chain.rs:200).
12:  - Template literal: when every hole is finite it expands to a concrete `LiteralUnion` (resolver/template.rs:18-27). Otherwise it stays a `TemplateLiteral` pattern with an Info diagnostic and no `degradedBy` (29-43).
13:  - Generic alias substitution: concrete (named.rs:148-176, substitute.rs:1-8). Unfilled parameters stay `Named` placeholders (named.rs:149-151).
14:  - The silent drop: when an alias's expansion is unevaluated, named.rs:178-188 returns `Named{name,args}` and throws the opaque away, so `degradedBy` stays empty. A test pins this: `from: Breakpoint` (an `infer` conditional) and `keys: Keys` (mapped) read as bare names (pipeline/tests.rs:1877-1922).
15:  - Generic call return type: `callee.rs` binds the type arguments and reads the component type (callee.rs:1-7). The fallback picks a type argument by shape (extractor/wrapper.rs:1-8), which is the name-matched factory guess ADR 0026:7 names. Both give concrete props.

23:  - `awaits_checker` is true only when a `CHECKER_PENDING` Info diagnostic is present (pipeline/semantic_hook.rs:124-136). It is pushed when the wait elapses (234-239).

27:## 2. Smallest contract change
28:
29:- Representation: keep `PropType::Opaque`. Add no PropType variant and no per-prop field. Add two `OpaqueReason` kinds:
30:  - `templateLiteral`, a template whose expansion needs an alias or a generic.
31:  - `genericApplication { expression }`, for an alias or utility instantiation, a generic call result, or `ReturnType`/`Awaited`/`Parameters`.
32:- Add `OpaqueReason::checker_decides()`. It is true for conditionalType, mappedType, indexedAccess, templateLiteral, genericApplication and moduleAugmentation. It is false for unresolvableImport, depthExceeded, unsupportedExpression, runtimeDependent and pandaCodegenMissing.
33:- "Pending" is derived, never stored. A prop is pending when its answer is structural (`awaitsChecker`, or `--no-checker`/fallback) and its `degradedBy` holds a `checker_decides` kind. `raw` keeps today's display text (`Breakpoint`, `StyleProp<Size>`), so the RDT view prints the same name. Only the marker is new.
34:- Where it is set (resolver only):
35:  - named.rs:182-188 returns `Opaque(genericApplication | inner kind)` instead of `Named`. This drops the `named_unevaluated` plumbing: global.rs:78, 187, 216, 226; memo.rs:115, 176, 247-286; primitives.rs:316.
36:  - collected.rs:118 stops reducing.
37:  - template.rs:20-27 expands only literal-only holes.
38:  - primitives.rs:175-221 reads a member only on a non-generic declaration and deletes the CSSProperties table.
39:  - substitute/alias utility evaluation at prop-type level.
40:- Merge: no code change is needed. A pending structural type already lets the checker's type win (semantic.rs:428). A prop the checker did not return keeps its pending type, and `structural_left` already counts it (semantic_hook.rs:339-341, `holds_opaque` output.rs:669-673).
41:- `awaitsChecker`: unchanged (semantic_hook.rs:130). Optional: a component whose every prop is pending waits `wait_empty`, like an empty one (one line in `wait_for`, 169-175).
42:- `degradedBy`: unchanged derivation (output.rs:1402). It lists the new kinds automatically.
43:- `--no-checker` and CLI JSON: `{"type":{"kind":"opaque","raw":"Breakpoint","reason":{"type":"conditionalType"}},"degradedBy":["conditionalType"]}`, plus the run diagnostic of ADR 0026:17.
44:- Schema and versions:
45:  - The `schema` command picks the kinds up from `KINDS` (crates/cli/src/commands/schema.rs:39-46). Its tests force `packages/napi/index.d.ts:37` (`OpaqueReason` union) and `output/tests.rs:959-961` to list them.
46:  - No `SCHEMA_VERSION` bump: a new reason value is an ignorable addition under ADR 0017:13-14. Watch out: ADR 0026:32 already plans a bump, so it may ride along.
47:  - No `CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION` bump: the cache holds `SourceData` only (cache.rs:1, 19, 55). A bump is needed only if the extractor slice changes `CollectedType`'s shape (`cache/golden.rs` and its `.snap`).
48:- Goldens and snapshots that change:
49:  - All 8 `crates/core/tests/snapshots/snapshots__snapshot_*.snap` (structural). Today they hold 0-2 opaque each, and they would gain pending props wherever aliases or utilities are used.
50:  - `apps/oracle/construct-suite/expectations.json` (the rows above, plus identical rows reached through reduce, template expansion, utilities or the CSSProperties table). I could not count them without a run.
51:  - `checker-expectations.json`: `generics/29` stops leaning on the fallback when the structural type is opaque too, so its entry goes stale and the lane fails until it is removed (README.md:147).
52:  - pipeline/tests.rs:1877-1922, tests/enum_props.rs:105, `output/tests.rs`, and the schema tests.
53:  - `crates/semantic/tests/snapshots/*` (checker) should not change.
54:
55:## 3. Extractor consequences
56:
57:- It must still collect:
58:  - candidates (evidence, uses)
59:  - prop names, optionality and declaration order for interfaces and type literals (the provisional list)
60:  - defaults, JSDoc and tags
61:  - union member order (ADR 0026:15, S7a2)
62:  - cva
63:  - the source text and file of every type-level node, which is now just `raw`
64:- It no longer needs the structure the evaluator walked: conditional branches with `infer`, mapped key and value types, template parts beyond literal-only, utility recognition, or alias type parameters and defaults. A later slice can collapse those `CollectedType` variants (types/collected.rs:171, 193, 203, 225) to `{ raw }`, with a `CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION` bump.
65:- The `wrapper.rs` type-argument choice (727 lines) is the factory guess. Without it a generic factory has no structural props, which already triggers the `wait_empty` path.
66:
67:## 3b. Replace or delete: which of (a), (b) or (c) each piece is
68:
69:- **Evaluation in named.rs:148-188** (alias expansion with arguments): (a). The checker returns the instantiated type, and the merge puts it in place of the structural type by name (semantic.rs:398-404). Its "keep the name" display is (c): the first answer needs `raw` for the pending prop.
70:- **evaluate.rs `reduce`, prop-type level** (collected.rs:118): (a). The checker evaluates conditionals and degrades only an open one (crates/semantic/src/convert.rs:781).
71:- **evaluate.rs `reduce`, prop-set level** (alias.rs:360-362): (a) for the final answer, since the prop set comes from the checker's `getPropertiesOfType`. (c) while first paint has to list Panda recipe props: an owner decision.
72:- **template.rs expansion** (18-27, `MAX_TEMPLATE_LITERAL_EXPANSIONS` 73-80): (a). The literal-only expansion is (c).
73:- **primitives.rs indexed access**: (a) for the member reads (175-183, 249-253) and the React table (187-221). The opaque fallback (255-266) is (c).
74:- **substitute.rs:439-477 and alias.rs:40/69/885-893/995-999 utilities at prop-type level**: (a). At chain level they are (c), with the same Omit/Pick first-paint decision.
75:- **callee.rs (391)**: (a). The S7b lane passes the factory and call rows on the checker alone (`components/03-factory`, ADR 0026:45). (b) would be needed only to keep a structural first answer, and that cannot be done without a snapshot. The calls exist (`getSignaturesOfType`, `getReturnTypeOfSignature`, `getTypeArguments` in crates/semantic), but they are not first-answer speed. So: delete.
76:- **extractor/wrapper.rs (727)**: (c) for candidate detection (ADR 0026:31). Its choice among the type arguments is (a).
77:- **dependency_types.rs (1,466)**: (c). With `--load-dependencies` it supplies the dependency declarations that the structural answer and `--no-checker` read (1-6). It is also watch's demand graph: pipeline/revision.rs:17, 313, 415-421. The demand-graph part is (b): S6 already lists every file the checker's program read (ADR 0026:44; `getSourceFileNames`), and that list could drive re-resolution when the checker is on. A per-component closure is still unsolved (ADR 0026:34).
78:- **import_map.rs (373)**: (c). Every structural answer needs name to specifier (1-5). A tsrs replacement (`getSymbolOfSourceFile`, `getExportsOfModule`, `getAliasSymbolOfType`) needs a snapshot and so cannot serve first paint.
79:- **extractor/reexports.rs**: (b) candidate, unverified. `getExportsOfModule` (already called in crates/semantic) could give a module's export list, which ADR 0027 keys components on. Gate: the `exports/` and `cross-file/` rows.
80:
81:## 4. Slice plan (disjoint source files)
82:
83:- P0, first (it blocks the others):
84:  - Files: types/output.rs (+2 kinds, `checker_decides`), packages/napi/index.d.ts, cli schema tests, output/tests.rs.
85:  - Gate: unit tests and `just lint doc-check machete typos`.
86:  - Deletes ~0, adds ~50.
87:- P1, named.rs + memo.rs + types/global.rs: an unevaluated alias becomes opaque, and `named_unevaluated` is deleted. Gate: the pipeline/tests.rs:1877 test rewritten to assert `degradedBy`. Deletes ~60-90.
88:- P2, collected.rs + evaluate.rs `reduce`: no conditional reduction at prop-type level. Keep `keys_of`, and keep the alias.rs:360 call until P4 decides about the prop set. Gate: an opaque conditional test, plus enum_props.rs:105. Deletes ~150-250 (estimate).
89:- P3, primitives.rs (indexed access): delete the CSSProperties/HTMLAttributes table and open-type member reads. Gate: an `indexedAccess` unit test. Deletes ~60.
90:- P4, template.rs + substitute.rs (prop-type utility and alias evaluation): only literal holes expand, and utilities become `genericApplication`. Gate: unit tests. Deletes ~150-300 (estimate).
91:- callee.rs + extractor/wrapper.rs (generic call results) is a fifth candidate. Hold it until the prop-set decision in section 5.
92:- Shared generated files (the 8 `.snap` files, `expectations.json`, `checker-expectations.json`) conflict across branches. Merge in order and regenerate on each rebase (insta and the structural lane), or keep each branch's gate on unit tests and add one closing slice that regenerates and reviews the goldens.
93:
94:## 5. Risks and what I could not determine
95:
96:- Prop-set evaluation (Omit/Pick at chain level, alias.rs:360 reduce for Panda recipes, callee and wrapper) is not per-prop. This contract leaves those sets provisional under the component's `awaitsChecker`. Removing them empties Panda and Mantine first paint until the checker answers (up to `wait_empty`, 2 s). This needs an owner decision.
97:- `fallback: 'degraded'` in the addon throws when the diagnostics carry incomplete-messages (provider.ts:180-184). I did not check whether new opaque diagnostics feed `incompleteMessages`. If they do, many more components will throw in that mode.
98:- Not run: the line counts are estimates, and so is the number of identical suite rows that would move. Measure with the structural lane, not the oracle.
99:- A `--no-checker` user loses concrete but correct reductions, for example `Partial<X>`. That is the stated trade-off. It is the last answer for no-checker hosts such as Vite and watch (ADR 0026:46).
100:- ADR 0022's first paint shows more `raw` names with markers. The UI currently has no per-prop pending styling (none found in packages/storybook/src).
